willEndure: To summarize, a 590 bps commodity headwind has been almost entirely offset by operating leverage, cost efficiency, and improved realization.
So, commodity inflation actually continues to be a major headwind.
I think on the headwinds, as I said in the beginning, diesel prices will continue to be a very important monitorable, as also the interest rates.

threats: Variable cost, with the principal headwinds at ₹1,416 crore, 590 basis point impact.

highlights: The volume momentum we saw in the last page translated into a 23% revenue growth for the quarter, which stood at ₹19,300 crore, EBITDA was ₹2,300 crore at a margin of 11.7%, down 60 basis points YoY.
EBIT margin was 9.4%, down only 20 basis points and PBT before exceptional items was ₹2,100 crore, up 26% year-on-year.
Free cash flow was ₹1,100 crore, against a negative ₹1,800 crore in Q1 last year.
Net cash stood at ₹7,100 crore as of June 30th, against ₹7,500 crore at March-end and this is after the ₹1,473 crore dividend payout during the quarter.
This is the walk from PBT before exceptional items of ₹1,635 crore in Q1 FY26 to ₹2,057 crore in Q1 FY27, and what you see below is the EBIT margin bridge.

willEndure: Net of all this, EBIT margin moved from 9.6% to 9.4%. and in summary, operating leverage and improved realisation have absorbed almost all of the significant commodity headwind.
strengths: Free cash flow was ₹1,100 crore, against a negative ₹1,800 crore in Q1 last year.
Coming to Free cash flow - for the quarter, FCF was ₹1,114 crore, against negative of ₹1,796 crore in Q1 FY26 - a swing of about ₹2,900 crore.
Consolidated free cash flow was ₹400 crore against a negative of ₹2,000 crore in Q1 of FY26.
threats: Variable costs were the principal headwind at ₹649 crore, or 340 basis points.
Steel, aluminium and copper flowing through into material cost, consistent with the headwinds that we flagged when we closed FY26.
Q1 wholesales were approximately 108,700 units, up 26% year-on-year; a robust quarter and one delivered through a period of heightened geopolitical tensions.
